messages:
Nina: Quick field notes from recent onboarding + renewal check-ins — consolidated asks from 4 accounts. TL;DR: top pain = lack of per-route cost visibility, causing billing confusion; second is model warmup/streaming latency during onboarding flows; third is request for reusable enterprise onboarding templates. Need product + eng input on prioritization and a 1-pager for AEs by Friday. @Sam can you take point?

Sam: Yep, can do. Can you paste the raw asks here so I can triage?

Nina: Pasting verbatim snippets from CS notes:
```
- Brightlane: "We see big variance between routes, need per-route token/cost breakdown in console or API. Our finance team is blocking onboarding without it."
- SummitHealth: "Long model warmup on first few requests causes pipeline timeouts during demo flows (30s+). Blocks integrations."
- NovaApps: "Would love a ready-made onboarding playbook (templates + example prompts) for enterprise customers to reduce setup time."
- AcmeRetail: "Requesting per-environment policy controls (staging vs prod) to avoid accidental spend."
```

Priya: Proposed scoring for the tracker: Impact (customer revenue / blocking?), Frequency (# of accounts reporting), Effort (rough dev sprints), Renewal risk (High/Med/Low). Suggest we mark Brightlane as high renewal risk until cost visibility is delivered.

Lee: Engineering notes: per-route billing UI + infra metrics ingestion looks like ~2 dev sprints + changes to billing pipeline. Warmup/timeouts might be mitigated with prefix/KV cache and lightweight warmup endpoint — need samples of request traces and seq length distribution. Streaming latency — could tune batching windows and fallback fewer tokens on cold starts. I can prototype options if someone drops sample traces. :wrench:

Alex: To add context: Brightlane renewal in Q2, health score ~70. If we can promise a short-term visibility patch + roadmap commit, we can keep them. I can push for a demo slot next week if we have a one-pager.

Sam: OK — I'll create tickets and add the scoring columns. Preliminary prioritization: P1 — SummitHealth warmup (demo blocker), P2 — Brightlane per-route visibility (billing impact + renewal risk), P3 — onboarding playbook template. Will need engineering estimates to finalize.

product-bot: Created ticket PROD-4821 "Per-route cost breakdown" assigned to Sam. https://tracker.company/PROD-4821

Nina: Action items: 1) Sam to update tracker + scores by Tue, 2) Lee to request traces and prototype warmup mitigations, 3) Priya to collect customer quotes for renewal context, 4) Alex to schedule AE demo if we have a one-pager. I'll compile a 1-pager draft Thursday for review.

Priya: I'll pull the direct CS quotes and include screenshots of the invoices they're referencing.

Lee: I'll put a short spike on my board for cache/warmup options and ping here when I have a plan.

Sam: I'll attach the scoring matrix to PROD-4821 and link accounts.

Nina: Great, thanks everyone. Will follow up in the tracker and share the one-pager draft. :thumbsup:
